KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_SPACEPORT: Acerra Spaceport is a majestic testament to humanity's past ambitions. This is where the Exodus shuttles, vessels of hope and desperation, once roared into the heavens, leaving a beleaguered Earth behind.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_WATERTREATMENTFACIL: Alcantara Power Plant, or "The Dam", stands as a silent sentinel amidst a toxic, waterlogged land, nourishing a riot of resilient vegetation and fauna. A monument echoing with the memories of power once generated.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_BURIEDCITY: Amidst the sand dunes in this arid wasteland you will find a remnant of the old world quite unlike the cold steel spires of the Exodus age. Walk these narrow streets and empty plazas, and know that people once lived here.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_PRACTICERANGE: Nestled in a secluded mountain hollow, the echoed gunshots from this practice range seem to confuse ARC's sense of direction, creating a rare pocket of open-air safety. Raiders use the Backyard to hone their skills, and catch up on some long-overdue stargazing.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_THEBLUEGATE: Once a steadfast symbol of defiant connection, the Blue Gate now serves as a daunting entryway into the perilous mountain ranges. The surrounding valley bears scars both new and old.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_MOUNTAINCOMPOUND: A secluded research facility amidst snow-draped peaks, Stella Montis is said to have been the last bulwark of humanity's preservation.
KeysToEntries.ID_GAMEMODE_LOCATION_FROZENTRAIL: This is a placeholder description for the Frozen Trail
